text: New work on compact image generation models, capability-centric data design, and real-world image editing evaluation.
I joined Alibaba’s AI Native Applications department as an Algorithm Engineer, working on virtual try-on.
I graduated from Sun Yat-sen University with a master’s degree in Control Science and Engineering.
We released Tstars-Tryon 1.0 and the Tstars-VTON benchmark.
WISA was accepted to NeurIPS 2025 as a Spotlight.
Dynamic Try-On was accepted to BMVC 2025; our monocular-to-3D virtual try-on work was accepted to IEEE TPAMI.
We released WISA for physics-aware text-to-video generation.
We released Dynamic Try-On for video virtual try-on.
We released VITON-DiT for in-the-wild video virtual try-on.
